Generated 2026-11-15 15:07 UTC from `https://nebo-backend-673540938891.us-central1.run.app/api/v1`.

For each catalogue target, chosen detector and SPHEREx epoch: the **expected** position (catalogue coordinates propagated with proper motion to the epoch's mid date, `expected_position` in `GET /timeline`) against the **measured** position (2D Gaussian fit to the float32 co-add `.npz`, finite pixels only, so saturated NaN cores are fitted from the PSF wings). Pixels are the large (15') PNG frame: 0-based, north up, row 0 at the top; 1 px = 6.15". A row passes when the offset is at most 1 px.

## Summary

- Epochs measured: 30; detected: 29; within 1 px: **29/29**.
- Unsaturated detections: 10/10 pass; worst 0.64 px (3.9", WISE 0855-0714 D5 epoch 2).
- Worst overall: 0.64 px (3.9", WISE 0855-0714 D5 epoch 2).
- Not detected (S/N < 5 near the expected pixel): WISE 0855-0714 D6 epoch 1.
- Saturated rows are less precise: the core is clipped or missing, so the centre comes from the wings. Barnard's Star, RW Aurigae and R Draconis saturate every detector.
- WISE 0855 in D5 is faint (S/N ~10) and blended with a background source 0.7-2 px away; its offsets all lean towards that source, so they bound the ephemeris error from above rather than measure it.
- R Draconis and RW Aurigae barely move (proper motion under 0.01 px/yr): their expected position is the image centre in every epoch. Barnard's Star, Eps Indi B and WISE 0855 move 0.8-1.7 px/yr, so their rows test the proper-motion propagation.

## Detectors chosen

| Target | Detectors | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Barnard's Star | D1, D5 | Saturated in every detector. D1 and D5 have no NaN core pixels in any epoch (D2-D4 lose the core in some epochs). Its 10.4"/yr motion (~1.7 px/yr) makes it the real test of the proper-motion propagation. |
| Epsilon Indi B | D3 | Clean, unsaturated point source in D3 (S/N 100-230), 4 epochs. |
| WISE 0855-0714 | D5, D6 | Only visible at the longest wavelengths: D5 detects it in all 4 epochs; D6 misses epoch 1, which is kept to show the no-detection case. In D1-D4 the fit lands on a fixed background source 0.7-2 px away, not the brown dwarf. |
| RW Aurigae | D1 | Saturated in every detector; D1 has the lowest peak (least clipped) and no NaN core. |
| R Draconis | D6 | Saturated Mira with NaN cores in every detector; D6 has the smallest hole (1-2 px) and the most epochs with that little damage (10). |
